# Explicit reuse and release boundary

The HPMS campaign is preserved in place. It is not imported at runtime, retasked,
retrofitted with SPS behavior or republished by this project.

| Component | Reuse | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Dynamical CLI 0.1.22 | Pinned public package and public scientific contracts | Its installed authority does not initially include SPS; a fresh reviewed local admission is required |
| Dynamical ProspectiveRef | Bind request to pre-experiment prediction digest | Digest does not establish scientific validity |
| Pi 0.85.1 | Native investigator transport and history | Package resolution replaces personal global paths |
| Historical scientific controller | Selected evidence/adoption/isolated-computation patterns and tests | No HPMS equations, observations, calibration or freezes |
| Historical retry/usage controls | Selected tested transport semantics | No sibling credential loader or copied session history |
| Published SPS studies | Source-specific observations and supported model components | No pooling of different lots/routes as one calibrated twin |

The historical HPMS runtime baseline is 45758eb2ccb96dd792c9b5687ca2fae4123e8284
(0.1.21), but it also has installed-bundle modifications. That Git SHA alone is
not a reproduction of the campaign and is not used as this repo's dependency.

The public source package and source-specific notices are the release unit. Local
runtime assembly, test evidence, inference records, full papers, correspondence,
unapproved physical data and unreleased evaluation outcomes stay outside it.
Before publication: verify rights for campaign-owned adaptations, source licenses,
dependency attribution, clean-clone execution, secret/private-path scan and source
versus synthetic versus physical labels. Nothing in this document publishes data
or grants laboratory access.
